person_state.estimand: one sampled person's scalar state, separate inference problem
person_state.observation: m independent readings given that scalar state

population_mean.estimand: mean of a synthetic population, separate inference problem
population_mean.observation: N independent donor means with known variance B + R/m

warning: Known variances and normal likelihoods; no AB1/AB2 biological thresholds.
joint_inference: None. Scalar task results are not pooled as independent blocks.
role_gate_test: Synthetic neural required-support declarations test interface logic, not calibrated neural operators.
